defs.def: physical or mental activity that you do to stay healthy or become stronger （身体或思想的）活动，锻炼，运动

ex.s: Tending to plants is an exercise in patience and learning.
ex.t: 照料植物是一种锻炼耐心和学习的过程。

ex.s: Stand Up and Exercise, Everybody!
ex.src: 2024浙江1月卷·第四部分 写作
ex.t: 大家站起来运动吧！

ex.s: But why doesn’t everyone enjoy exercising?
ex.t: 但为什么不是每个人都喜欢锻炼呢？

ex.s: While physical exercise isn’t that bad, it’s still typically unpleasant.
ex.t: Explorer营地每节课都会组织有趣的美术、历史和科学相关活动，重点关注强调主动学习、探索，最重要的是——乐趣的主题！

ex.s: The thing is, regular exercise to get “in shape” requires constant and considerable effort — all for gradual progress and uncertain rewards.
ex.t: 问题是，为『塑形』而进行的规律锻炼需要持续且大量的努力——而这一切只是为了渐进的进步和不确定的回报。

ex.s: Most people have the habit of doing physical exercise.
ex.t: 大多数人都有做体育锻炼的习惯。

ex.s: Most people do physical exercise for comfort and pleasure.
ex.t: 大多数人做体育锻炼是为了舒适和愉悦。

ex.s: Exercise is good for you, and polluted air isn’t）.
ex.t: 锻炼对你有益，而受污染的空气则不然。

ex.s: Taking too many types of exercises.
ex.t: 做太多类型的运动。

ex.s: Do some exercise.
ex.t: 做一些运动。

ex.s: Think about the exercises you would like to do with your workout partner.
ex.t: 想想你想和健身搭档一起做的锻炼。

ex.s: And among people who don't exercise, the changes can start even sooner.
ex.t: 而在不运动的人身上，这些变化可能开始得更早。

ex.s: Levine and his research team selected volunteers aged between 45 and 64 who did not exercise much but were otherwise healthy.
ex.t: Levine和他的研究团队选择了45至64岁之间不常运动但其他方面健康的志愿者。

ex.s: The second group did high-intensity aerobic exercise under the guidance of a trainer for four or more days a week.
ex.t: 第二组在教练指导下进行高强度有氧锻炼，每周四天或更多。

ex.s: "The sweet spot in life to start exercising, if you haven't already, is in late middle age when the heart still has flexibility," Levine says.
ex.t: "如果你还没有开始运动，生命中开始运动的最佳时期是中年晚期，这时心脏仍有弹性，"Levine说。

ex.s: Middle-aged hearts get younger with aerobic exercise.
ex.t: 中年人的心脏通过有氧运动变得更年轻。

ex.s: High-intensity exercise is more suitable for the young.
ex.t: 高强度运动更适合年轻人。

ex.s: It is never too late for people to start taking exercise.
ex.t: 开始运动永远不嫌晚。

ex.s: The more exercise we do, the stronger our hearts get.
ex.t: 运动越多，心脏越强健。

ex.s: We all know that cycling is a greatly exercise.
ex.t: 我们都知道骑自行车是一项极好的运动。

ex.s: The benefits of regular exercise are well documented but there’s a new bonus to add to the ever-growing list.
ex.t: 定期锻炼的好处已有充分记载，但在这个不断增长的清单上又增加了一个新好处。

ex.s: Positive effects of doing exercises.
ex.t: 运动的积极效果。

ex.s: Exercises suitable for the middle-aged.
ex.t: 适合中年人的运动。

ex.s: Why did the researchers ask the woman to do bicycle exercise?
ex.t: 研究人员为什么要让女性做自行车运动？

ex.s: More Women Are Exercising to Prevent Dementia
ex.t: 更多女性通过运动预防痴呆症

ex.s: Middle-Aged Women Need to Do More Exercise
ex.t: 中年女性需要做更多运动

ex.s: We will be holding a free taster session on 23rd May, at 10 am, to demonstrate the variety of effective and active exercises.
ex.t: 我们将于5月23日上午10点举办一场免费体验课，展示各种有效且活跃的锻炼方式。

ex.s: Doing regular exercises.
ex.t: 做定期锻炼。

ex.s: However, far less has been known about how meal timing and exercise might affect general health.
ex.t: 然而，关于进餐时间和运动如何影响整体健康，人们所知要少得多。

ex.s: The implication of these results is that to gain the greatest health benefits from exercise, it may be wise to skip eating first.
ex.t: 这些结果的暗示是，为了从运动中获得最大的健康益处，先不进食可能是明智的。

ex.s: Their lack of exercise led to overweight.
ex.t: 他们缺乏运动导致超重。

ex.s: What happened to those who ate breakfast before exercise?
ex.t: 那些在锻炼前吃早餐的人发生了什么？

ex.s: Lifestyle is not as important as morning exercise.
ex.t: 生活方式不如晨练重要。

ex.s: Physical exercise before breakfast is better for health.
ex.t: 过度运动会减慢新陈代谢率。

ex.s: “This works just like physical exercise, ” says Francisca Then, who led the study.
ex.t: "这就像体育锻炼一样，"领导这项研究的弗朗西斯卡·滕说。

ex.s: Why does the man seldom do exercise？
ex.t: 这个男人为什么很少锻炼？

ex.s: To recommend an exercise.
ex.t: 为了推荐一项运动。

ex.s: How much time will the man probably spend exercising weekly？
ex.t: 这个男人每周可能会花多少时间锻炼？

ex.s: Why does the man seldom do exercise？
ex.t: 这个男人为什么很少锻炼？

ex.s: To recommend an exercise.
ex.t: 为了推荐一项运动。

ex.s: How much time will the man probably spend exercising weekly？
ex.t: 这个男人每周可能会花多少时间锻炼？

ex.s: The best exercise is one that you enjoy and will do.
ex.t: 最好的运动是你喜欢的并且会坚持的运动。

ex.s: Exercising makes you more awake and ready to handle whatever is ahead of you for the day.
ex.t: 锻炼使你更加清醒，准备好应对当天面临的任何事情。

ex.s: Exercise energizes you, so it is more difficult to relax and have a peaceful sleep when you are very excited.
ex.t: 运动会让你精力充沛，所以当你非常兴奋时，更难放松并获得安宁的睡眠。

ex.s: After you exercise, you continue to burn calories throughout the day.
ex.t: 根据世界银行的数据，中国占全球化肥总消费量的约30%。

ex.s: If you are planning to do exercise regularly, or you’re doing it now, then listen up!
ex.t: 如果你计划定期锻炼，或者你现在正在锻炼，那就听好了！

ex.s: Do you want to get up in time to have breakfast with your family, get in some exercise, or just be better prepared for your day?
ex.t: 你是想按时起床和家人一起吃早餐、做些运动，还是想更好地为新的一天做准备？

ex.s: Do some exercise.
ex.t: B．给她父亲打电话。

ex.s: But people don't take as much exercise as they used to.
ex.t: 但人们不像以前做那么多运动了。

ex.s: Not so long ago, I didn’t do any exercise - not even any jogging!
ex.t: 就在不久之前，我什么运动都不做——连慢跑都不做！

ex.s: A total of 92 women were in the medium fitness category; and 59 women were in the low fitness category, defined as a peak workload of 80 watts or less, or having their exercise tests stopped because of high blood pressure, chest pain or other cardiovascular problems.
ex.t: 共有92名女性属于中等健康水平；59名属于低健康水平，定义为峰值负荷80瓦或以下，或因高血压、胸痛或其他心血管问题而停止运动测试。

ex.s: The right way of exercising.
ex.t: 锻炼的正确方式。

ex.s: It’s this strange form that makes race walking such an attractive activity, however, says Jaclyn Norberg, an assistant professor of exercise science at Salem State University in Salem, Mass.
ex.t: 然而，位于马萨诸塞州塞勒姆的塞勒姆州立大学运动科学助理教授Jaclyn Norberg说，正是这种奇特的形式使竞走成为一项如此有吸引力的运动。

ex.s: I only joined my local athletics club because my doctor told me that in my particular case exercise could improve how my lungs work.
ex.t: 我之所以加入本地田径俱乐部，完全是因为我的医生告诉我，就我而言，运动可以改善我的肺功能。

ex.s: But the study was small and needs to be repeated with far larger groups of people to determine exactly which aspects of an exercise routine make the biggest difference.
ex.t: 但这项研究规模小，需要用大得多的人群重复，以确切确定锻炼计划的哪些方面影响最大。

ex.s: You can keep your head clear for 4-10 hours after exercise.
ex.t: 运动后你可以保持头脑清醒4到10小时。

ex.s: You wouldn’t think that a few    58   (month) of exercise in your teens would be enough    59    the rest of your life, and that’s also true for building your vocabulary—you have to keep at it daily, and pretty soon you will find that you have an excellent vocabulary.
ex.t: 你不会认为十几岁时几____58____（month 个月）的锻炼就足以____59____（受益）余生，建立词汇量也是如此——你必须每天坚持，很快你就会发现自己拥有出色的词汇量。

ex.s: ●   39   Studies found that people who woke up early for exercise slept better than those who exercised in the evening.
ex.t: ● ____39____研究发现早起锻炼的人比晚上锻炼的人睡得更好。

ex.s: "We put healthy 70-year-olds through a yearlong exercise training program, and nothing happened to them at all."
ex.t: 我们让健康的70岁老人参加为期一年的锻炼计划，他们根本没有任何变化。

ex.s: So, if your “ideal” self is a professional footballer, and your “actual” self isn’t, your “ought” self is the one that spends a lot of time training, exercising, and getting better at football.
ex.t: 所以，如果你的"理想"自我是一名职业足球运动员，而你的"现实"自我不是，那么你的"应然"自我就是那个花大量时间训练、锻炼、并提高足球水平的人。

ex.s: Maybe it is because the combination of fresh air, smooth movement and exercise.
ex.t: 也许是因为新鲜空气、平稳的运动和沿途风景的结合。

ex.s: These genes were much more active when the men had fasted before exercise than when they had breakfasted.
ex.t: 这些基因在男性运动前禁食时比吃早餐时活跃得多。

ex.s: As far as your brain is concerned, there are processes that discourage exercise, and processes that encourage it.
ex.t: 就你的大脑而言，有些过程会阻碍锻炼，有些过程则会促进锻炼。

defs.def: a set of movements or activities that you do to stay healthy or develop a skill （保持健康或培养技能的）一套动作，训练活动，练习

ex.s: There are different levels of exercises for different age groups and we must do them according to our own health and age.
ex.t: 有针对不同年龄组的不同强度练习，我们必须根据自己的健康和年龄来做。

ex.s: It involves doing very slow physical exercises to relax your mind and calm your body.
ex.t: 它涉及做非常缓慢的身体练习，以放松你的头脑，平静你的身体。

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
ex.t: 可以想象，与构建以往科学模型的过程类似，发展这种基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具价值的实践。

ex.s: They might even like to have a go at doing the exercise.
ex.t: 他们甚至可能想试做一下这个练习。

ex.s: He makes philosophical thought an appealing exercise that improves the quality of our experiences, and he does so with plenty of humor.
ex.t: 他让哲学思考成为一种吸引人的练习，提升我们体验的质量，而且他做得充满幽默。

defs.def: a set of questions in a book that tests your knowledge or practises a skill 习题；练习
the use of power, a skill, a quality or a right to make sth happen 行使；运用；使用
an activity that is designed to achieve a particular result （为达到特定结果的）活动
a set of activities for training soldiers （士兵的）操练，演习，演练
to use your power, rights or personal qualities in order to achieve sth 行使；使用；运用
to do sports or other physical activities in order to stay healthy or become stronger; to make an animal do this 锻炼；训练；操练

ex.s: This time they found the exercise much more interesting.
ex.t: 那个男人僵了一秒，但当他看到这个瘦弱的男孩时松了一口气。

ex.s: It helps to exercise a person's mind.
ex.t: 它有助于锻炼一个人的心智。

ex.s: The increase of energy will even make you more willing to exercise, and that will raise your overall energy even more.
ex.t: 精力的增加甚至会让你更愿意锻炼，而这会进一步提高你的整体精力水平。

ex.s: You should exercise for at least half an hour each day.
ex.t: 你应该每天锻炼至少半小时。

ex.s: There is no reason you should exercise in the morning.
ex.t: 你没有理由非要在早上锻炼。

ex.s: If you are already making the time to exercise, it is good indeed!
ex.t: 如果你已经在腾出时间锻炼，那真是太好了！

defs.def: to give a part of the body the movement and activity it needs to keep strong and healthy 锻炼（身体某部位）
if sb is exercised about sth, they are very anxious about it 使焦虑；使不安；使烦恼
